title: Tomato spoilage at North Mandi Market
description: Farmers lose massive quantities of fresh tomatoes daily due to lack of cold storage facilities and extreme heat during transport.

title: Vegetable rot at farmer coop yard due to heat
description: Our agricultural cooperative yard has no refrigeration. Vegetables, particularly spinach and tomatoes, spoil rapidly under afternoon sun. We need a low-cost, off-grid cooling solution.

title: Tomato damage during distribution transit
description: Freshly harvested tomatoes get crushed and rot during shipping to central markets because of non-insulated packaging and unrefrigerated trucks.

title: High nitrate contamination in community wells
description: Recent drinking water tests show high levels of nitrates and chemical runoff in several community tubewells, likely from nearby farms.

title: Agricultural fertilizer runoff polluting village drinking wells
description: Our well water is unsafe for infants. Tests show dangerous levels of nitrate pollutants originating from surrounding crop fields' fertilizer runoff.

title: Traffic gridlock at Metro Station Circle
description: Major traffic jams occur daily at the Metro Station junction due to uncoordinated signal timing and passenger boarding congestion.

title: Congestion and signal delay at metro boarding hub
description: Fixed timers on traffic lights at the metro junction cause massive rush hour delays. Signals don't adapt to changing vehicle densities.

title: Crop loss due to pest infestation
description: Unusual insect swarms are destroying legume crops in the block, and local pesticide treatments are failing.

title: Lack of soil nutrient analysis labs
description: Smallholder farmers are applying incorrect ratios of nitrogen fertilizers because soil testing services are 50km away.

title: Inefficient solar crop drying
description: Grain farmers suffer mold damage post-harvest. Traditional sun-drying takes too long and exposes crops to rain.

title: Fodder shortage in dry seasons
description: Dairy farmers lack high-nutrition silage storage solutions to keep milk yields consistent during summer droughts.

title: Soil salinity in coastal farms
description: Rising sea levels have caused salt intrusion in arable lands, preventing traditional paddy germination.

title: Delayed crop harvesting bottlenecks
description: Lack of shared mechanical harvesters forces small farm owners to delay harvesting, causing grain shattering.

title: Low milk yield due to cattle heat stress
description: Milch cows suffer from thermal stress in poorly ventilated sheds, reducing summer milk yields by 30%.

title: Fluoride poisoning in school supply
description: Primary school borewell tests indicate toxic levels of natural fluoride, leading to dental fluorosis in children.

title: Rainwater harvesting system failures
description: Rooftop storage tanks installed in public buildings are leaking and have silted up due to poor filter design.

title: Groundwater depletion in irrigation zone
description: Heavy deep-bore tubewell operation has dropped the local water table by 15 meters, drying out shallow hand pumps.

title: Urban lake eutrophication
description: Discharge of raw sewage and detergent effluents has caused massive algal blooms, choking local fish populations.

title: Siltation of community irrigation canal
description: Monsoon mudslides have filled the main irrigation channel with clay silt, blocking flow to downstream farmlands.

title: Drinking water pipe leakage losses
description: Old cast iron water mains are leaking over 40% of treated municipal water into subterranean sand layers.

title: Waterborne pathogen outbreak after flood
description: Contamination of open drinking water tanks has caused gastroenteritis cases among villagers.

title: Industrial heavy metal dumping in canal
description: Small scale plating factories dump untreated chromium effluents into the common drainage canal.

title: Lack of neonatal warming devices
description: Rural primary health centers lack functional incubators, leading to hypothermia risks in preterm infants.

title: Delayed tuberculosis diagnosis
description: Sputum test samples take two weeks to return results from the district hospital, causing transmission risks.

title: High incidence of anemia in adolescent girls
description: Local schools report high absenteeism due to severe iron-deficiency anemia among teenage students.

title: No ambulance access across river
description: During monsoon washouts, villages across the local river are cut off from emergency obstetric care.

title: Improper medical waste incineration
description: Community clinics are burning medical plastics in open pits, releasing toxic dioxin fumes near residential yards.

title: Insulin storage failures in power cuts
description: Diabetes patients in remote clinics lose cold-chain integrity for stored insulin during extended power failures.

title: Mental health counseling shortage
description: Stress levels are high among rural youth, but the nearest psychiatric consultation is at the state capital.

title: Snakebite antivenom supply shortage
description: Monsoon season sees high snakebite incidents, but health sub-centers do not stock cold-chain antivenom vials.

title: High dropout rates among rural girls
description: Lack of functioning separate toilets at secondary schools causes female students to drop out at puberty.

title: Lack of science experiment kits
description: Government high schools teach chemistry and physics theoretically because of zero laboratory budgets.

title: Dysfunctional computer lab hardware
description: Donated computers are lying unused due to lack of local technical maintenance support and power surges.

title: Illiteracy in local tribal dialects
description: Children from tribal communities fall behind early because instruction materials are not in their native tongue.

title: Inadequate braille reading textbooks
description: Visually impaired students in public schools receive printed braille books months after the term starts.

title: Poor teacher attendance in remote hamlets
description: Teachers struggle with long commutes to hill schools, leading to frequent classroom closures.

title: Lack of vocational career counseling
description: High school graduates migrate to cities for manual labor due to zero awareness of technical trade training.

title: No internet connectivity for e-learning
description: Broadband lines do not reach the rural school block, making government digital learning portals useless.

title: Deforestation of catchment hills
description: Illegal firewood logging has cleared the slope forest, causing mudslides during heavy monsoons.

title: Plastic bag choking storm drains
description: Single-use shopping bags block the underground gutter system, causing flash floods in streets.

title: E-waste accumulation in landfill
description: Discarded electronics are mixed with regular household waste, leaching lead and mercury into ground soil.

title: Air pollution from brick kilns
description: Unregulated clay brick manufacturing kilns emit thick black soot, causing respiratory issues in surrounding villages.

title: Loss of local honeybee populations
description: Excessive neonicotinoid pesticide sprays on mustard crops have decimated native pollinator colonies.

title: Riverbank erosion washing houses
description: Fast currents during monsoon floods erode the soft sandy banks, destroying riverside settlements.

title: Methane emission from organic dump
description: Wet food waste from the city market decays anaerobically, creating strong odor and fire hazards.

title: High cost of diesel generator pumping

title: Biomass cookstove smoke pollution
description: Women suffer chronic respiratory diseases due to soot from traditional wood-burning stoves in unventilated kitchens.

title: Solar microgrid battery failures
description: Community solar installations stop working within 18 months due to battery overheating and lack of replacements.

title: Voltage fluctuations damaging pumps
description: Unstable grid voltages burn out agricultural pump motors, requiring expensive rewinding repairs.

title: No street lighting in high crime zones
description: Absence of public illumination on dark lanes increases safety risks for night shift workers.

title: Biogas digester winter failure

title: Lack of wind turbine maintenance

title: Inadequate sewage treatment capacity
description: The municipal treatment plant overflows during rains, releasing raw sewage into the public river corridor.

title: Unpaved road dust causing allergies
description: Heavy truck traffic on unpaved bypass roads kicks up fine silica dust, causing widespread asthma.

title: Pothole damage causing motorcycle crashes
description: Monsoon rains wash away asphalt, leaving deep craters that cause frequent two-wheeler accidents.

title: Lack of public drinking fountains
description: Commuters suffer heat exhaustion due to zero access to clean drinking water stations in transit hubs.

title: Overcrowded public bus boarding gates
description: Bus stops lack queue lanes or platforms, causing dangerous stampedes during peak office hours.

title: No fire hydrant network in dense slums
description: Narrow lanes prevent fire engines from entering, and there are no pressurized water mains nearby.

title: Corrosion of iron pedestrian bridges
description: Humid weather and saline air have rusted the support beams of the city walkover bridges, threatening collapse.

title: No wheelchair ramp at public library
description: The municipal archive has only steep stone stairs, blocking access for citizens with mobility impairments.

title: Absence of audio signals at crosswalks
description: Visually impaired pedestrians cannot safely cross the busy metro station intersection without assistance.

title: Lack of sign language translators in clinics
description: Deaf patients struggle to explain symptoms to doctors due to absence of translation services.

title: Non-accessible government website forms
description: Screen readers cannot parse the dropdowns on the state portal, preventing disabled users from applying for pensions.

title: High steps on public transit buses
description: Bus entry steps are 40cm high, making boarding impossible for wheelchair users and senior citizens.

title: Braille markings missing on elevators
description: Elevator buttons in the public court complex lack tactile markings, disorienting blind visitors.

title: Heavy heavy doors at bank entrances
description: Spring-loaded entry doors require too much force, blocking access for frail individuals.

title: Non-adjustable school desks for disabled
description: Students using wheelchairs are forced to sit far away from whiteboards due to fixed seating.

title: Mishandled community grievances

title: Lack of cold storage for fish catch

title: Lack of credit history for women groups

title: Decline in bamboo craft tool efficiency

title: No packaging standards for honey harvest

title: Cocoa bean fermentation failures
